map.匀加速位移计算器依据 x=v₀t+½at² 求位移，综合初速度、加速度与时间，适: The constant-acceleration displacement calculator uses x=v₀t+½at² to solve displacement from initial velocity, acceleration and time — ideal for kinematics problems, free fall and vehicle braking distance estimates.

map.匀加速时平均速 = (v₀+v)/2，位移 = v̄×t，与该式等价；非匀加速不: Under constant acceleration the average speed = (v₀+v)/2 and displacement = v̄×t, equivalent to this formula; it does not apply to non-uniform acceleration.
